Package chess.model

Enum Class PieceColor

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<PieceColor>
chess.model.PieceColor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<PieceColor>, Constable
public enum PieceColor extends Enum<PieceColor>
The two players in a chess game.

Each color knows the one-letter prefix used to display any of its pieces (for example, w in wp) and the direction its pawns move on the board array.

  • Field Details

    • prefix

      private final char prefix
      The letter shown before a piece's symbol on the board.

    • forwardDirection

      private final int forwardDirection
      The row change for one step "forward". White moves toward rank 8, which is array row 0, so its direction is -1. Black's is +1 since it's "forward" is the opposite direction.
